title: Reinforcements rushed as search for missing SPOs intensified in J-K's Kishtwar

ai.summary: Security forces intensified search for two missing Special Police Officers in Jammu and Kashmir's Kishtwar district after they went missing while traveling from camp to an Army post.

facts.claim: Security forces have rushed reinforcement and widened the search for two missing Special Police Officers (SPOs) across the forested upper reaches of Dachhan in Jammu and Kashmir's Kishtwar district for the second consecutive day on Thursday
facts.quote: Security forces have rushed reinforcement and widened the search for two missing Special Police Officers (SPOs) across the forested upper reaches of Dachhan in Jammu and Kashmir's Kishtwar district for the second consecutive day on Thursday

facts.claim: Specialised teams equipped with drones and sniffer dogs have been deployed across the forested stretches and difficult mountainous terrain
facts.quote: Specialised teams equipped with drones and sniffer dogs have been deployed across the forested stretches and difficult mountainous terrain

facts.claim: Babi Chand, 57, and Rashpal Kumar, 45, both posted with the Special Operations Group (SOG) of the local police at Kiyar village in Dachhan, went missing on Wednesday while travelling from their camp to an Army post at Dharna-Marwah
facts.quote: Babi Chand, 57, and Rashpal Kumar, 45, both posted with the Special Operations Group (SOG) of the local police at Kiyar village in Dachhan, went missing on Wednesday while travelling from their camp to an Army post at Dharna-Marwah

facts.claim: Their mobile phones were initially reachable but were later switched off, raising concerns among security agencies and prompting to launch an extensive search operation
facts.quote: Their mobile phones were initially reachable but were later switched off, raising concerns among security agencies and prompting to launch an extensive search operation

facts.claim: Additional police and Army personnel have been deployed to intensify the search, with multiple teams fanning out across the vast forested stretches and difficult mountainous terrain
facts.quote: Additional police and Army personnel have been deployed to intensify the search, with multiple teams fanning out across the vast forested stretches and difficult mountainous terrain

facts.claim: They said the operation has been expanded to cover a wider area around Kiyar and the route towards Dharna-Marwah. Drones are being pressed into service to scan inaccessible forest stretches and rugged terrain, while sniffer dogs are assisting ground teams in tracking possible movement
facts.quote: They said the operation has been expanded to cover a wider area around Kiyar and the route towards Dharna-Marwah. Drones are being pressed into service to scan inaccessible forest stretches and rugged terrain, while sniffer dogs are assisting ground teams in tracking possible movement

facts.claim: The search parties are combing dense forests, natural trails and remote pockets to establish the whereabouts of the missing personnel
facts.quote: The search parties are combing dense forests, natural trails and remote pockets to establish the whereabouts of the missing personnel

facts.claim: They said all possible angles were being examined to ascertain the circumstances surrounding their disappearance. However, they cautioned against linking the incident to militant activity at this stage, saying it would be premature to draw any conclusion until the facts emerge
facts.quote: They said all possible angles were being examined to ascertain the circumstances surrounding their disappearance. However, they cautioned against linking the incident to militant activity at this stage, saying it would be premature to draw any conclusion until the facts emerge

facts.claim: Kishtwar has remained a focus of counter-insurgency operations, with security forces continuing efforts to eliminate the remaining terrorist presence in its remote and forested areas
facts.quote: Kishtwar has remained a focus of counter-insurgency operations, with security forces continuing efforts to eliminate the remaining terrorist presence in its remote and forested areas

facts.claim: Successive counter-insurgency operations have resulted in the killing of several active terrorists, significantly weakening their presence in the district
facts.quote: Successive counter-insurgency operations have resulted in the killing of several active terrorists, significantly weakening their presence in the district

facts.claim: According to the figures available, five people, including four terrorists and one Army soldier, were killed in terror-related incidents in 2026. In 2025, the toll stood at four, comprising three terrorists and one Army soldier. In 2024, three security personnel and two civilians lost their lives
